content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 — elevated error rate and sustained request surge targeting model family raven-13b. Autothrottle triggered on a subset of hosts. Alerting on 90th pctl latency and 5xx count.
emily (oncall): saw the pager, joining. any idea scope? customers? :wave:
mike (sre): errors are 502/504 from the serving tier, CPU high on the shard group running raven-13b. traffic spike ~3x over baseline starting 2025-11-02T09:18Z.
tanya (ops): are we seeing a correlated increase in long-context requests?
emily (oncall): looking at logs now, lots of streaming sessions with seq_len > 4096. some customers doing batch transform-like calls.
luca (infra): autothrottle dropped global RPM but the per-model carveouts still allowed heavy traffic to raven-13b. we should tighten per-model quotas.
mike (sre): propose immediate mitigation: lower raven-13b RPM from 1200 -> 300 and TPM from 1,200,000 -> 350,000, temporarily; route excess requests to fallback model raven-7b or queue.
emily (oncall): agree. want minimal customer impact — can we keep embeddings and light-token calls unaffected?
jane (eng-runtime): yes we can target the generator route only. do not touch embeddings or reranking routes.
tanya (ops): drafting customer impact note for support: affected customers will see rate-limited generation calls for raven-13b; streaming sessions over long context may be cutoff. prepping canned responses.
support-bot: Identified 12 paying customers currently hitting >=50% of recent raven-13b usage: AcmeCorp, PixelShare, TutorAI, FinLens, HealthQ. Auto-created support tickets: #5234-#5245.
emily (oncall): mike/luca can you run the quota change? share the command you want me to approve.
luca (infra): running internal tool — preview only: 
```
quotactl preview --model raven-13b --set rpm=300 --set tpm=350000 --routes=generator --note "emergency sculpt 2025-11-02 surge"
```
Preview shows expected dropped requests ~58% for that family and fallback to raven-7b for compatible routes.
mike (sre): after preview, execute: 
```
quotactl apply --model raven-13b --set rpm=300 --set tpm=350000 --routes=generator --ttl 2h --rollback-on-failure
```
I'll watch the rollout. emily will you ack in channel before apply?
emily (oncall): ack, apply once i see the preview ok — go ahead.
luca (infra): applying now. this is a fast path change; will hit edge-config within ~30s.
incident-bot: change initiated by luca. Job ID: job-0x7f5a. Estimated completion 00:00:30.
emily (oncall): +1 watching logs. mike help watch 5xx and p99 latency, tanya handle customer comms.
mike (sre): p99 latency dropping already on affected hosts. 5xx count trending down. will keep eyes on autoscaling churn.
incident-bot: quota update completed. job-0x7f5a: success. New limits in effect.
emily (oncall): initial impact: errors for some sessions replaced with 429 for generator route. support ticket auto annotated.
tanya (ops): sent update to impacted customers, included temporary workaround: pin to raven-7b or contact support for dedicated carveouts.
jane (eng-runtime): noticed an unintended side-effect: a small fraction of streaming clients saw truncated final tokens when fallback kicked in. investigating to make fallback preserve EOS.
mike (sre): will open a follow-up to run targeted fallback improvement in next maintenance window. not rolling back.
emily (oncall): current system health: errors down 78% vs peak, latency 90th improved 45%, costs reduced. Good for now.
tanya (ops): support queue stabilized after the note. no escalations to sales so far.
luca (infra): I'll schedule a capacity re-balance for raven-13b shards to restore headroom; estimated 4h work.
emily (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 20m. next steps: 1) monitor for 2h TTL on quota (auto-rollback if regress), 2) collect sample of affected requests for postmortem, 3) update status page w/ mitigation note. assign follow-ups to mike/jane/luca.
mike (sre): i'll own postmortem and KPIs.
jane (eng-runtime): i'll follow up on streaming fallback fix.
tanya (ops): I'll keep support briefed and escalate any revenue-impacting tickets.
emily (oncall): ok handing off — @oncall-night you are on deck. thread locked for updates; if new surge appears, page SRE. :white_check_mark: 
incident-bot: Handoff recorded: emily -> oncall-night. Incident remains P1.
emily (oncall): finishing notes in incident tracker and closing the active mitigation loop.
